# Synthetic transport contracts

`contracts.json` contains synthetic examples, not captured customer payloads.
The [Tilda webhook documentation](https://www.help.tilda.cc/forms/webhook) confirms
POST, product arrays and the externalid option, but does not establish every field path.
Flat products, nested payment and SKU fixtures exercise the configurable adapter.
Do not label these fixtures as verified payloads of the actual OhMySmell Tilda project.
Before enabling intake, add an anonymized real capture and its confirmed field/item map.
